mapProfile.thesis: Restore warning calls and skyline signals by mastering tempo and reading multi-part Tells.
bossPrepHints: Keep Open Sky Guard ready before the Beacon-Breaker's Molt-triggered calls.
Spend Wingbeat early to outrun stacking Winded Tells.
Sequence Plumes and Quills so a single big turn lands before the next telegraph resolves.

enemies.name: Signal Marshal
enemies.lesson: Elite: charges a beacon, then unloads a heavy strike.
enemies.description: A disciplined signal hawk that charges the spire beacons before diving through the flock's formation.
enemies.visualBrief: Lean raptor in a structured signal-marshal wind shell, narrow harness straps, talon bands, and beacon clips standing with antenna-cage signal styling.
enemies.silhouette: Tall angular officer shape with swept wings and a beacon-backed perch.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, body angled slightly left or right with face and head aligned to the same 3/4 angle; enemy appears braced, watchful, or ready to act while staying readable; full body visible with natural wings, tail, and talons, standing on an implied ground line with weight supported by natural feet, talons, paws, or webbed feet; avoiding straight-on symmetry, floating poses, and human shoulder posture.

enemies.name: Relay Starling
enemies.lesson: Read a two-part Tell that adds Winded after damage.
enemies.description: A fast relay starling that carries warning calls between antennas and leaves the flock winded in its wake.
enemies.visualBrief: Small iridescent starling in a cropped courier jacket, tiny message tube, bright talon bands, and wind-tugged feathers with relay-wire courier styling.
enemies.silhouette: Small darting bird with pointed wings and a message-runner forward lean.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, body angled slightly left or right with face and head aligned to the same 3/4 angle; enemy appears braced, watchful, or ready to act while staying readable; full body visible with natural wings, tail, and feet, standing on an implied ground line with weight supported by natural feet, talons, paws, or webbed feet; avoiding straight-on symmetry, floating poses, and human shoulder posture.

enemies.name: Aerial Kite
enemies.lesson: Punish Open Sky telegraphs and keep tempo.
enemies.description: A high circling kite that marks exposed routes, then drops through the open air when tempo slips.
enemies.visualBrief: Long-winged kite in a light windbreaker wrap, chest strap, and reflective feather-safe tabs against a pale skyline and exposed spire gap.
enemies.silhouette: Wide high-soaring raptor with a forked tail angle and open-sky arc.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, body angled slightly left or right with face and head aligned to the same 3/4 angle; enemy appears braced, watchful, or ready to act while staying readable; full body visible with natural long wings, forked tail, and talons, standing on an implied ground line with weight supported by natural feet, talons, paws, or webbed feet; avoiding straight-on symmetry, floating poses, and human shoulder posture.

enemies.lesson: Survive a Heavy Strike that hits harder when you lack Cover.
enemies.description: A stubborn tower pigeon that roosts in the signal works and slams harder when the flock has no cover.
enemies.visualBrief: Heavy city pigeon in layered roost vest, soft neck wrap, utility leg bands, and soot-dusted feathers beside breaker boxes and antenna mounts.
enemies.silhouette: Round solid bird with puffed chest, short neck, and planted roost stance.

enemies.lesson: Manage tempo against a fast bird that builds toward a bonus strike.
enemies.description: A static swift that snaps between wires, building charge-like momentum through speed rather than magic.
enemies.visualBrief: Sleek swift in a narrow racing shell, tiny strap harness, and reflective trim cutting across taut signal wires in rain and city light.

enemies.lesson: Respect a heavy multi-part Tell that punishes a thin Molt.
enemies.description: A beacon grackle that guards the signal lights and punishes flocks that molt under exposed skyline.
enemies.visualBrief: Glossy grackle in a rumpled black-blue signal jacket, small beacon charm clips, talon bands, and a utility perch lit by practical warning lamps.
enemies.silhouette: Medium glossy bird with long tail, raised head, and warning-call chest.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, body angled slightly left or right with face and head aligned to the same 3/4 angle; enemy appears braced, watchful, or ready to act while staying readable; full body visible with natural wings, long tail, and feet, standing on an implied ground line with weight supported by natural feet, talons, paws, or webbed feet; avoiding straight-on symmetry, floating poses, and human shoulder posture.

enemies.lesson: Optional elite that stacks Winded and Open Sky pressure together.
enemies.description: A sharp-eyed signal kite that patrols the spires alone, layering wind pressure with exposed-route calls.
enemies.visualBrief: Lean signal kite in a cobalt courier shell, wind-cut flight straps, amber reflective bands, clipped route tags, and small antenna charm beside rooftop signal hardware.
enemies.silhouette: Long-winged raptor with a forked tail, narrow talons, signal straps, and a strong diagonal courier profile.

enemies.lesson: Optional elite that punishes slow tempo and missed openings.
enemies.description: A tollkeeper kestrel posted at a rooftop signal crossing, reading every hesitation from a rope-tag gantry before diving into the lane.
enemies.visualBrief: Compact kestrel in a sharp toll-runner jacket, weathered sling pouch, talon wraps, reflective rope tags, and clipped toll-wire charms beside an antenna gantry and rain-dark rooftop crossing.

enemies.name: The Beacon-Breaker
enemies.description: A storm-black signal boss that breaks old warning beacons and turns every exposed molt into a citywide alarm.
enemies.visualBrief: Large dark raptor-corvid presence in a heavy signal mantle, wind-cut straps, talon bands, and broken beacon fragments atop a storm-lit spire.
enemies.silhouette: Huge high-perch bird with broken-beacon framing, broad wings, and a severe downward gaze.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, body angled slightly left or right with face and head aligned to the same 3/4 angle; enemy appears braced, watchful, or ready to act while staying readable; full body visible with natural wings, tail, and talons, standing on an implied ground line with weight supported by natural feet, talons, paws, or webbed feet; avoiding straight-on symmetry, floating poses, and human shoulder posture.

enemies.name: Cicada Static Swarm
enemies.lesson: Static caller: tempo pressure grows if the flock lets it hum.
enemies.description: A representative signal cicada whose rattling wing buzz scrambles tells in dense spire weather.
enemies.visualBrief: Single large cicada enemy in tiny signal-safe strap accents and reflective tags on a utility box, with natural transparent wings unobstructed.
enemies.silhouette: Small insect with broad wings, stout body, round eyes, and vibrating-ready posture.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, one readable cicada grounded or perched low, not a cluster or cloud.

enemies.name: Crane Signal Caller
enemies.lesson: Signal support elite: calls Open Sky pressure before a long reach strike.
enemies.description: A tall signal caller that turns skyline distance into marching pressure.
enemies.visualBrief: Sandhill crane in a wind-cut neck wrap, fitted signal sash, long leg bands, and small route tags beside antenna cages.
enemies.silhouette: Very tall bird with long legs, straight neck, narrow beak, and lookout stance.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, standing on natural long legs with wraps fitted close and no robe-like costume.

enemies.name: Bat Nightcaller
enemies.lesson: Disruptor: bad-direction Snags and exposure pressure vary the Spire tempo mix.
enemies.description: A night-roost bat that rattles the flock's timing with sharp calls around tower lights.
enemies.visualBrief: Little brown bat with a minimal flight-safe collar, tiny reflective tags, and wing membranes fully unobstructed in a dim utility alcove.
enemies.silhouette: Small winged mammal with wide natural wings, pointed ears, and compact body.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, grounded or resting naturally with wings readable and not covered by capes or sleeves.

enemies.name: Kite Hawk Courier
enemies.lesson: Aerial hit-and-run: line up Open Sky, then sweep through weak Cover.
enemies.description: A skyline courier that sweeps through predictable lanes and tests whether the flock reads the incoming pass.
enemies.visualBrief: Slender kite in a lightweight courier shell, wind-cut straps, talon bands, and route tags against antenna masts and roof gaps.
enemies.silhouette: Lean raptor with pointed wings, narrow head, long tail, and fast diagonal profile.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, grounded on talons in a poised pre-launch stance rather than flying.

enemies.name: Moth Lantern-Drifter
enemies.lesson: Night distractor: Cover, Winded, and bad-direction Snags vary Spire street pressure.
enemies.description: A night moth that drifts around service lamps and draws attention away from harder threats.
enemies.visualBrief: Large moth with tiny body-safe reflective tags and no wing coverings near a practical lantern and rain-specked utility glass.
enemies.silhouette: Soft wide-wing insect with small body, feathery antennae, and flutter-ready stance.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, single readable moth grounded or resting low, wings natural and unobstructed.

signals.title: Dead Beacon
signals.prompt: A burned-out skyline beacon could be relit to mark the route, but climbing the spire leaves the flock exposed.

signals.title: Crossed Wires
signals.prompt: Tangled signal wires hum across the gap. Untangling them takes time, but a quiet landing could ease the next exposed crossing.

choices.text: Rig an Open Sky guard line.

signals.title: Warning Caller
signals.prompt: A lone caller still keeps the old warning songs. It will teach a sharper opening cry in exchange for help or supplies.

signals.title: Static Nest
signals.prompt: A nest wrapped in crackling static interference. Clearing it might restore a lost Waymark or scramble your deck.

signals.title: Fading Waymark
signals.prompt: A weathered sign flickers with the last traces of an old Waymark. You could preserve it, trade it for scrap, or let it fade and find your own path.

choices.text: Mark it with your own route.

signals.title: Wind Shear Passage
signals.prompt: Brutal wind shear cuts across the spire gap. Toughen the flock now, or accept the wind and land stronger afterward.

signals.title: Picker's Roost
signals.prompt: A roost full of shiny things: scrap, supplies, cards. You have time for one haul before the owner returns.

signals.title: Healer's Refuge
signals.prompt: An old healer still tends to injured birds in a sheltered tower alcove. Sanctuary, but at a cost.

choices.lockedText: Need a free supply slot and 20 Scrap.

choices.text: Learn her remedy — and her story.

signals.title: The Toll Gambit
signals.prompt: A figure at the tower crossing collects tolls — payment or peril. Most birds pay. Some don't make it across.
